prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign in to keep your pet safely backed up", "body": "Already created a pet? Signing in restores your existing companion and saves all your progress across devices.", "hint": "Use your primary email to retrieve previous pets automatically."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Diagnostic Wait Info: Display a progress bar with a time estimate and tray icon tip while the app initializes the desktop window overlay.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Setting up desktop overlay...", "body": "Your pet is getting ready to land on your screen. If your desktop is crowded, check your system tray.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Photo Upload Redesign: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a carousel layout with embedded photo quality guidance tips.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Refine Your Custom Companion Visuals", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"role": "photo_upload", "type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Photo"}, {"role": "photo_upload", "type": "tip_carousel", "text": "For best results, use well-lit photos with clear lighting."}]}}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Two-Column Path Choice Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column view comparing instant starter companions side-by-side with custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Journey", "body": "Pick an instant starter companion or create a customized custom desktop pet."}}
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Access System Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and add system tray interaction hints to the welcome screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Click your desktop tray icon anytime to minimize, hide, or customize your companion."}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Verification Sub-Flow: Insert a companion trait preview validation sub-flow right before issuing the adoption certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_adoption_preview": {"headline": "Verify Companion Appearance", "body": "Review your companion's design and expression before final placement.", "layout": "centered"}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Alternative Sign-In Stalling Hint: Add a fallback hint on the sign-in screen recommending magic links if authentication stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Having trouble? Select passwordless magic link to sign in without stalling."}}
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop System Tray Controls Guide Screen: Add a system tray controls guide screen after home introduction to explain how to hide, summon, or talk to the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_companion_tray_guide"], "new_companion_tray_guide": {"headline": "System Tray & Desktop Controls", "body": "Learn how to toggle pet visibility and change desktop sound settings from your system tray.", "layout": "checklist"}}
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop Asset Initialization Step Counter: Display step counters and active asset load status text during the waiting phase.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "body": "Preparing desktop environment assets and window overlays..."}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Path Switch Reassurance Hint: Display a hint reassuring users that additional pets can be added later regardless of the selected path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can change or add more pets later at any time from the app settings."}}

verdicts.reason: Clarifies sign-in functionality without violating any base rules.
Adds setup progress information while maintaining the waiting step requirements.
Redesign retains photo upload capability and adds photo quality tips.
Offers both adopting and custom creation options in a two-column layout.
Adds desktop system tray access hints during home introduction within onboarding.
Inserts a valid preview sub-flow without removing any required onboarding steps.
Provides sign-in fallback guidance without breaking any onboarding rules.
Adds a guide screen following home introduction, allowed under onboarding rules.
Enhances wait screen details while preserving its primary function.
Provides clear reassurance about path selection without introducing pricing claims.
